description: Defines functions and external variables related to paging mechanisms in a Git repository context, including setup, checking usage, and formatting terminal output.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Returns the pager command used for the repository, considering whether stdout is a terminal.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes pager settings for the repository.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to finish.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a pager is currently in use.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the terminal.

methods.name: term_clear_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the terminal.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a decimal number.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Verifies the pager configuration command for the repository.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares arguments for the child process used as pager.

calls: stdlib functions such as strcmp, atoi, etc. are not directly listed but may be used internally.
other external functions are not explicitly called in this header but would be in implementation.
